label: Counting work per unit type
subgoals: Count the operations of each type
Divide by the number of units of that type
Round up to get the step bound for that type

label: Multicycle operations occupy units longer
subgoals: Multiply the operation count by the occupancy per operation
Divide the unit-steps of work by the number of units
Use occupancy one for fully pipelined units

label: Combining the bounds
subgoals: Compute the critical-path length of the DFG
Compute the bound for every unit type
Take the maximum as the lower bound on schedule length
